result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render consistently. Excluding the expected carousel edge-clipping and bottom viewport cutoff, only minor visual inconsistencies remain: an unbalanced promo banner with empty space on the right, a low-contrast delivery-fee meta line, and a partially visible category chip at the right edge that lacks a fade/scroll affordance.

issues.description: The green promo banner's text and 'Order now' button occupy only the left half; the right half contains only faint decorative circles, leaving the banner visually unbalanced with a large empty region.
issues.suggestion: Add supporting imagery (e.g., a delivery/bike illustration) or center-align the copy so the banner's right side does not read as empty broken space.

issues.description: Secondary meta text such as '€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery' and '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' is rendered in a light gray on the light background, giving low contrast for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the meta text color to meet WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1) for small body text.

issues.description: The category chip row ends with a sliver of another chip visible at the right edge with no scroll affordance (no fade gradient or peeking label), which can look like a rendering artifact rather than intentional scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or ensure a meaningful portion of the next chip peeks in so horizontal scrollability is clearly signalled.
